subject: ACME trial: procurement path, success criteria & billing start
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acme.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2027-02-18T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Trial next steps & procurement questions

Thanks again for your time this morning — great to see how the ACME search team is thinking about integrating Redwood. Quick recap and a few procurement questions so we can keep the trial moving smoothly:

- Success criteria (as discussed): ingest 250k docs, achieve latency < 250ms p95 for standard queries, and a 15% increase in retrieval accuracy on our benchmark prompts.
- Trial duration: 30 days starting when you onboard (see setup doc attached).
- Next steps for us: provision trial instance, assist with prompt/eval setup, and set up a weekly check-in.

Procurement/commercial items we need to confirm:
1) Billing method: PO (invoice) vs corporate card?
2) Marketplace: would you prefer to purchase via AWS Marketplace or direct?
3) Who owns the procurement/PO at ACME (name/email)?
4) Any required SOW or DocuSign flow we should prepare?

Attachments: redwood-trial-setup.pdf, acme-procurement-questions.xlsx

If you can confirm procurement path and the contact, I can loop in our contracts team and have a SOW/DocuSign ready. I also recommend a short call with Rishi (solutions) and Connor (CS) to align on success criteria and metrics — can do 30 minutes tomorrow.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood-trial-setup.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: acme-procurement-questions.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acme.com>, Daniel Park <dpark@acme.com>
Date: 2027-02-18T14:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Trial next steps & procurement questions

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. This aligns with our internal notes. Quick answers: 

- Billing: Procurement prefers PO/invoice for contracts over $5k — we will need a PO.
- Marketplace: We use AWS Marketplace for smaller purchases, but for vendor contracts and PO we'd prefer direct (vendor-managed invoicing).
- Procurement owner: Daniel Park (cc'd) handles POs and SOW routing.

We'll need the SOW and an invoice template to route through our systems. The success criteria you listed look good; I'll confirm with the search team on the ingest target to make sure 250k is achievable in the trial window.

Can we do the 30-minute alignment tomorrow at 10am PT?

Best,
Samantha
Senior Product Manager, Search | Acme Corp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>, Daniel Park <dpark@acme.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2027-02-19T08:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Trial next steps & procurement questions

Perfect — thanks Daniel and Samantha. We're set to prepare a SOW and invoice template for PO flow. Quick notes before the call: 

- If PO + invoice is the path, billing will typically start the day after the trial end unless you request billing-on-success (we can invoice only after success criteria are met, but that requires a signed SOW specifying gating criteria).
- Marketplace purchases (AWS) complicate PO routing; since you prefer direct PO, we'll skip marketplace for the initial contract.
- For the SOW: would you like a fixed term with a 30-day trial embedded, or a trial addendum to a master services agreement? If Daniel can advise on legal preference that'd be helpful.

I'll put together a draft SOW (ACME-SOW-v1.docx) and a sample invoice template. Rishi will include pricing and any trial-to-paid thresholds. Connor will help onboard and track the success metrics during the trial.

Call confirmed: 2027-02-19 10:00 AM PT — dial-in details in calendar invite.

Thanks — talk soon.
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>, Daniel Park <dpark@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2027-02-19T10:55:00-08:00
Subject: ACME pricing & SOW v1

Hi all — following the call, attaching the initial SOW and a short pricing note so procurement has what they need. Highlights: 

- Trial: 30-day trial, provisioned with a trial invoice for $0.
- Success gating for conversion: 250k docs ingested OR average monthly query volume >= 100k (either threshold triggers review).
- Billing start: by default, billing begins the day after trial ends (2027-03-20) unless PO/SOW specifies billing on-success; if ACME wants billing-on-success we need the signed SOW with explicit gating criteria.
- Payment terms for enterprise PO: Net 30 after invoice date.

Attaching: ACME-SOW-v1.docx (draft), sample-invoice-template.pdf

Happy to jump on procurement calls and expedite the PO process.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ACME-SOW-v1.docx (docx)]
[Attachment: sample-invoice-template.pdf (pdf)]

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <dpark@acme.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acme.com>
Date: 2027-02-19T16:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: ACME trial: procurement path, success criteria & billing start

Thanks everyone — that works. Procurement will proceed with PO + Net 30. Daniel will circulate the PO template by EOD; we'll aim to have a signed SOW next week.

Two clarifications for the onboarding team: 
1) If we hit the ingestion threshold (250k) earlier, can billing be triggered immediately or do you prefer to keep billing start tied to trial end?
2) We'll also test the query-volume threshold during the pilot; Connor, can your team provide a short dashboard for the trial to show progress against the two thresholds?

Marissa/Rishi — please send the final SOW and invoice template to Daniel and cc procurement@acme.com. Thanks — excited to get started.

Best,
Samantha
Senior Product Manager, Search | Acme Corp
